text.description_html:
Yale Accentra Fire Rated Rim Exit Device 2100F-36-630

Providing a higher standard of ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 performance, the 2100 Series Exit Device is the right choice for meeting the rigors of everyday use. This economy exit device is now available with the ASSA ABLOY ACCENTRA™ SquareBolt® rim latch for the toughest applications. In addition to traditional painted finishes, the 2100 Series is available in an attractive satin stainless steel finish for use where aesthetics are also important.

The 2100(F) is a rim exit device to be used with single doors or pairs of doors constructed of metal, wood or composite materials. The 2100(F) can be paired with a wide variety of trims to meet many applications.

These Grade 1 exit devices are non-handed and for doors 30" - 36" wide.

Features and Specifications:

  • High-grade steel components offer superior protection against wear & tear
  • Latch: Pullman, SquareBolt®
  • Backset: 2-3/4" Covers 161 prep, includes latch & strike filler plates
  • Strike: Surface mounted for 5/8" stop with shim
  • Stile: Minimum 4-1/2"
  • Fasteners: Machine screws and wood door fasteners standard for panic hardware. Sex nuts and bolts supplied standard for fire exit hardware
  • Projection: 2-1/2" (64mm) active, 1-3/4" (44mm) depressed
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Minimum Door Thickness: 1-3/4" standard
  • Door Width: 36"
  • UL/cUL Listed
  • ISO 9001 Certification
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.23, Grade 1
  • Warranty: 3 Year Limited
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
